accepted.sentence: In an auto repair bay, a long-handled hand tool tightens engine-mount fasteners after the powertrain has been positioned.
Under a kitchen sink, a plumber turns the basin-retaining nut in the confined space around the fixture.
During farm equipment maintenance, technicians secure loose guards and brackets before machinery returns to field service.
On construction sites, workers tighten scaffold couplers as they assemble temporary access structures.
A heating technician turns a radiator pipe union nut while repairing a home's hot-water system.
At an appliance workshop, repairers secure compressor mounting bolts after replacing a refrigerator component.
In a machine shop, machinists tighten nuts on workholding fixtures before beginning a cutting operation.
During a remote repair, a portable generator's fittings can be tightened without relying on powered equipment.
